acceptanceCriteria: Each miss reports its kind, the value and the test location.
Dynamic or templated values count as prefixes.
Known false-positive classes (catch-all routes, patterns inside regular expressions) are labelled.
The check is name-level only and says so.
Output is bounded and the check is read-only.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1025 (owner, 2026-10-17). Tests can name a route, selector or mocked endpoint that exists nowhere in the application; a stub that never matches reaches the real backend or waits, and a selector with no source always times out, found only after a slow run. Proposal: 'tests refs-check' reports routes, selectors and mocked endpoint segments referenced by tests but absent from application source, reusing the existing application-map extraction of routes and selectors.
title: tests refs-check: static name-level check that test routes, selectors and mocked endpoints exist in the app (GitHub #1025)
